# BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn

BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn is a child and adolescent psychiatric clinic located in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], operating as a department under the region [^src2] [^src6]. The clinic assesses and treats school-aged children referred for ADHD evaluation and appears repeatedly in the national ADHD-databasen quality reports for 2023 and 2024, which track how well Danish child psychiatric units meet standardized diagnostic and treatment indicators [^src12].

The clinic's performance on **Indikator 3** — which measures diagnostic conferences held within 120 days of the start of an assessment — is its most notable storyline. In the 2023 report (covering data through early 2024), the clinic achieved 36% fulfillment of Indikator 3 across 80 assessment pathways (29 of 80, 95% CI 26–48) [^src1]. By the 2024/25 reporting period, the clinic had become the highest-performing unit nationally on this indicator, rising from 34% in 2023/24 to 66% in 2024/25 (196 of 299 pathways, 95% CI 60–71) [^src9]. This improvement is explicitly highlighted in the report as the largest gain of any unit in the country [^src9].

The clinic also reports on somatic health screening (Indikator 1), where it reported 59 of 80 pathways with somatic assessment (74%) in the 2023 data [^src6], improving to 96% fulfillment in the 2024/25 period — among the highest results nationally, alongside its sister unit BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn, which reached 95% [^src7]. On other indicators the clinic's results were much weaker: it recorded 0% fulfillment (10%, 95% CI 7–13, 48 of 479 pathways) on what appears to be a coordinating network-meeting indicator in the 2023 report [^src2], and 0% (60%, 95% CI 56–65, 289 of 479) on a related measure in the same period [^src3]. In the 2024 data, the clinic reported 8% fulfillment (43 of 517 pathways, 95% CI 6–11) [^src10], 56% on another measure (289 of 517, 95% CI 51–60) [^src11], and 61% (313 of 517, 95% CI 56–65) on a further indicator [^src12]. A separate figure lists 128 of 299 pathways at 43% (95% CI 37–49) for an indicator in the 2024/25 period [^src8], and the clinic is also referenced with a count of "3" pathways in an appendix on disconfirmed suspicion cases [^src5] and a count of "61" in a further appendix table [^src13].

The clinic reports its results to the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]] [^src12], the quality database that underpins both the 2023 and 2024 annual reports on ADHD diagnostics in Denmark. Within these reports, the clinic is consistently identified as part of Region Midtjylland's child and adolescent psychiatric services, alongside its counterpart clinic for younger children, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn [^src7].
